changelog:
- Clarified compatibility and tool integration: now references and recommends the `golang-pkg-go-dev` (godig) and `golang-gopls` (gopls) skills for code navigation and Go package information.
- Updated compatibility notes to include Codex and similar tools; enhanced metadata for clarity.
- Added a `paths` key for improved Go file targeting.
- Removed the `skill-card.md` file (no longer maintained in this version).
- Improved documentation to distinguish when to use this skill versus related skills, and highlighted preferred sources for Go package facts.
summary: Golang application framework using uber-go/fx — fx.New, fx.Provide, fx.Invoke, fx.Module, fx.Lifecycle hooks, fx.Annotate (name/group/As), fx.Decorate, fx.Supply, fx.Replace, fx.WithLogger, and signal-aware Run(). Apply when using or adopting uber-go/fx, when the codebase imports `go.uber.org/fx`, or when wiring services with fx.New. For raw DI without lifecycle, see `samber/cc-skills-golang@golang-uber-dig` skill.
